summary: Tested LOTR 5e Treasure System equipment selector and editable prices features. All backend APIs working (GET /api/data/weapons, GET /api/data/armors, PUT /api/data/treasure-config with pricing tables). Frontend 'Armas Famosas' tab correctly displays category selector (Arma/Armadura/Escudo) and equipment base selector from DB. Frontend 'Precios' tab displays editable pricing tables with configModified/pricesModified flags working correctly.

integration_issues.issue: When selecting equipment priced in 'mc' (copper), the conversion to 'mp' (silver) results in 0 for low-priced items. E.g., Bastón (2 mc) converts to 0 mp instead of 0.2 mp. Consider either keeping decimals or showing 'mc' price when conversion is <1 mp.

action_items: Minor: Consider improving price conversion handling for items priced in mc to avoid showing 0 mp for sub-1mp items
critical_code_review_comments: Backend PUT /api/data/treasure-config now correctly saves blessings, weaponQualities, armorQualities, shieldQualities (fixed during testing)
Frontend correctly loads weapons from /api/data/weapons and armors from /api/data/armors
Price autocomplete working when selecting equipment from dropdown
Precio Base remains manually editable after equipment selection
configModified and pricesModified state flags properly set when editing pricing tables
updated_files: /app/backend/routes/data_routes.py - Updated PUT /treasure-config to save pricing tables
seed_data_creation: Test treasure config data created and reset during testing

All edits trigger configModified badge. Backend now properly saves all pricing fields.
